mapper.select: SELECT c.city_code_no AS cityCodeNo, c.city_name AS cityName, d.district_code_no AS districtCodeNo, d.city_code_no AS districtCityCodeNo, -- 별칭 (혹시 DistrictVO의 cityCodeNo에 넣으려면!) d.district_name AS districtName FROM city_code c LEFT JOIN district_code d ON c.city_code_no = d.city_code_no ORDER BY c.city_code_no, d.district_code_no
